# Everything about Mutation in Fallout 76: How to get and remove it

![All about Mutation in Fallout 76: How to get and remove it](/uploads/5_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update June 13, 2025] Changed Mutations & Strengthened Genes Perk Card

Here at Nuka Knights, we usually discuss mutations as a matter of course since most people know them inside out. Here is another article with all the information for reference and links.

## HOW DO YOU GET MUTATIONS?

You get mutations either randomly through radiation you are exposed to or specifically by taking **mutation serums**. You can make these serums yourself using the corresponding serum recipe (available in mode in the Whitespring Bunker (Science Terminal) from around 17,500 bottle caps), or buy them from other players. Immediately after you have consumed a mutation as a serum, the negative effects are suppressed for 1 hour. The mutation then works as intended with all positive and negative effects. By taking Rad-X you briefly suppress the effects of your mutations. **Diluted Rad-X** does not suppress the mutations.

## HOW TO KEEP THE MUTATIONS?

Basically, you lose individual mutations again, for example if you take a bike away. Therefore, from level 30 onwards you can equip the card "**Strengthened Genes**" under Endurance (before 2025 under Luck) and keep your mutations. With this perk you no longer mutate randomly and keep the mutations you activated with serums. If you want to get mutations again at random, you can take out the card. In addition to "Strengthened Genes", you should also always equip "**Class Freak**" (from level 46) to reduce the negative effects of mutations by up to 75%.

## HOW TO REMOVE CERTAIN MUTATIONS?

If you want to remove individual mutations, you can't do it specifically. You can only remove random individual mutations and then take the ones you want to use again as serum. To do this, get all the mutations that you want to use after the action as a serum, then temporarily remove the “Strengthened Genes” card from your skills. Now you can take RadAways, you now lose one random mutation per RadAway. When the desired mutation has been removed, equip "Strengthened Genes" again and take the serums whose mutations you had to remove again.

## THE FOLLOWING MUTATIONS EXIST IN FALLOUT 76

The effects are described in more detail in PipBoy in the left tab under Effects. Here is a list of all effects:

- 
**Eagle eyes***Positive:*
 Critical Damage +50%, +4 Perception*Negative:*
 -4 Strength (without class freak)
 -1 Strength (with class freak 3*)*Builds:*
Commando / Single Shot Sniper & Pistol Builds
- 
**Adrenal reaction [changed]***Positive:*
 You deal more damage per kill during a killstreak (max. 10). Your maximum health will be reduced.*Negative:*
 -50 Max TP (without class freak)
 -12 Max TP (with Class Freak 3*)*Builds:*
All build variants
- 
**Charged***Positive:*
 Chance to hit the opponent with electric shocks during melee attacks*Negative:*
 A small portion of the damage can be dealt to the player.
 (Barely noticeable with class freak)*Builds:*
Primarily melee, but can help all builds
- 
**Marsupial***Positive:*
 +20 Carrying Capacity, +Jump Height*Negative:*
 -4 Intelligence (without class freak)
 -1 Intelligence (with Class Freak)*Builds:*
All
- 
**Chameleon***Positive:*
 Invisible while standing still or crouching if no armor or "weightless" armor (all pieces) is worn.*Negative:*
 Does not work with most armor.*Builds:*
Full Life Sniper with Weightless Armor
- 
**Egghead***Positive:*
 +6 Intelligence*Negative:*
 -3 Strength, -3 Stamina (without class freak)
 -0.75 Strength, -0.75 Stamina (with Class Freak)*Builds:*
All with them
